stem: As of January 1, 2008, all tariffs and quotas were eliminated on U.S. exports to Mexico and Canada under the ______?______ . . . . The dismantling of trade barriers and the opening of markets has led to economic growth and rising prosperity in all three countries.
instruction: Which of the following correctly completes this description?

options.label: H
options.text: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

visual_elements: A text box containing a quoted passage and a question mark indicating a missing term to be completed.
Four answer options labeled F, G, H, and J with corresponding text.
